description.value: Olio's Pizzeria & Eatery is a sit-down pizza restaurant in Fort St. John serving the Peace River region of northeastern BC. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, making it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through the area. It is one of the established local pizza destinations in a community that serves as a common resupply hub on northern BC touring routes.
